item.title: Frequently Asked Questions
item.description:
<div class="panel-group" id="accordion">

 <div class="panel panel-default">
 <div class="panel-heading">
 <h4 class="panel-title">
 <a data-toggle="collapse" data-parent="#accordion" href="#faq1">
 How does the student-tutor matching process work?
 </a>
 </h4>
 </div>
 <div id="faq1" class="panel-collapse collapse in">
 <div class="panel-body">
 After you submit a request, our academic advisors review your goals, current course syllabus, and learning preferences. We then pair you with an instructor whose academic background, teaching style, and schedule best match your needs.
 </div>
 </div>
 </div>

 <div class="panel panel-default">
 <div class="panel-heading">
 <h4 class="panel-title">
 <a data-toggle="collapse" data-parent="#accordion" href="#faq2">
 Where do tutoring sessions take place?
 </a>
 </h4>
 </div>
 <div id="faq2" class="panel-collapse collapse">
 <div class="panel-body">
 Most sessions are conducted online using interactive video platforms with collaborative digital whiteboards, screen sharing, and saved lesson notes. In-person tutoring is also available depending on your location.
 </div>
 </div>
 </div>

 <div class="panel panel-default">
 <div class="panel-heading">
 <h4 class="panel-title">
 <a data-toggle="collapse" data-parent="#accordion" href="#faq3">
 What is the 100% Fit Guarantee?
 </a>
 </h4>
 </div>
 <div id="faq3" class="panel-collapse collapse">
 <div class="panel-body">
 If you or your child are not completely satisfied with your tutor match after the initial session, we will match you with a new instructor at no extra charge.
 </div>
 </div>
 </div>

 <div class="panel panel-default">
 <div class="panel-heading">
 <h4 class="panel-title">
 <a data-toggle="collapse" data-parent="#accordion" href="#faq4">
 What academic subjects and test prep do you cover?
 </a>
 </h4>
 </div>
 <div id="faq4" class="panel-collapse collapse">
 <div class="panel-body">
 We cover K–12 Math (Pre-Algebra to Calculus BC & Multivariable), Sciences (Biology, Chemistry, Physics), Computer Science & Programming (Python, Java), Humanities, Academic Writing, and standardized test prep (SAT, ACT, AP Exams, SSAT/ISEE).
 </div>
 </div>
 </div>

</div>

<div class="text-center" style="margin-top: 40px;">
 <p class="lead">Have more questions?</p>
 <a href="/contact/" class="btn btn-template-main">Contact Our Team</a>
 <a href="/get-tutored/" class="btn btn-default" style="margin-left: 10px;">Request a Tutor</a>
</div>

item.title: Get Tutored
item.description:
Getting matched with an Elevate tutor is fast and free to start. Fill out the request form below, and our academic team will follow up within 24 hours to set up a free consultation.

<div class="box">
 <div class="heading text-center">
 <h3>Student Intake & Tutor Request Form</h3>
 </div>

 <form action="https://formspree.io/f/YOUR_FORM_ID" method="POST">
 <div class="row">
 <div class="col-sm-6">
 <div class="form-group">
 <label for="student_name"><strong>Student Name *</strong></label>
 <input type="text" class="form-control" id="student_name" name="student_name" placeholder="e.g. Alex Smith" required>
 </div>
 </div>

 <div class="col-sm-6">
 <div class="form-group">
 <label for="email"><strong>Parent / Contact Email *</strong></label>
 <input type="email" class="form-control" id="email" name="email" placeholder="alex@example.com" required>
 </div>
 </div>
 </div>

 <div class="row">
 <div class="col-sm-6">
 <div class="form-group">
 <label for="grade_level"><strong>Grade Level</strong></label>
 <select class="form-control" id="grade_level" name="grade_level">
 <option>Middle School (Grades 6–8)</option>
 <option selected>High School (Grades 9–12)</option>
 <option>College / University</option>
 <option>Adult Learner</option>
 </select>
 </div>
 </div>

 <div class="col-sm-6">
 <div class="form-group">
 <label for="format"><strong>Preferred Format</strong></label>
 <select class="form-control" id="format" name="format">
 <option selected>Online (1–2 hrs / week)</option>
 <option>Online (3+ hrs / week intensive)</option>
 <option>In-Person (Local)</option>
 </select>
 </div>
 </div>
 </div>

 <div class="form-group">
 <label for="subjects"><strong>Subject(s) Needed *</strong></label>
 <input type="text" class="form-control" id="subjects" name="subjects" placeholder="e.g. AP Calculus BC, SAT Math, Python, Physics" required>
 </div>

 <div class="form-group">
 <label for="notes"><strong>Academic Goals & Details</strong></label>
 <textarea id="notes" class="form-control" name="notes" rows="4" placeholder="Tell us about specific challenges, upcoming tests, or desired goals..."></textarea>
 </div>

 <div class="text-center" style="margin-top: 25px;">
 <button type="submit" class="btn btn-template-main btn-block btn-lg"><i class="fas fa-paper-plane"></i> Submit Tutor Request</button>
 <p class="help-block text-muted" style="margin-top: 10px;">We respect your privacy. No commitment required for consultation.</p>
 </div>
 </form>
</div>

Frequently Asked Questions

How do online sessions work?

Sessions are conducted via interactive HD video calls with real-time shared digital whiteboards, screen sharing, and recorded lesson archives.

item.title: Join as a Tutor
item.description:
Are you passionate about teaching and helping students achieve academic breakthroughs? Join Elevate's network of top-tier educators, university scholars, and credentialed mentors.

Competitive Pay

Premium hourly rates that respect your subject mastery and dedication.

Flexible Scheduling

Set your own availability around college classes, research, or work.

Remote & In-Person

Teach online from anywhere, or meet students locally when preferred.

<div class="box">
 <div class="heading text-center">
 <h3>Tutor Application Form</h3>
 </div>

 <form action="https://formspree.io/f/YOUR_FORM_ID" method="POST">
 <div class="row">
 <div class="col-sm-6">
 <div class="form-group">
 <label for="name"><strong>Full Name *</strong></label>
 <input type="text" class="form-control" id="name" name="name" placeholder="e.g. Jordan Lee" required>
 </div>
 </div>

 <div class="col-sm-6">
 <div class="form-group">
 <label for="email"><strong>Email Address *</strong></label>
 <input type="email" class="form-control" id="email" name="email" placeholder="jordan@university.edu" required>
 </div>
 </div>
 </div>

 <div class="row">
 <div class="col-sm-6">
 <div class="form-group">
 <label for="degree"><strong>University / Degree Program *</strong></label>
 <input type="text" class="form-control" id="degree" name="degree" placeholder="e.g. UC Davis, B.S. Computer Science" required>
 </div>
 </div>

 <div class="col-sm-6">
 <div class="form-group">
 <label for="experience"><strong>Teaching / Tutoring Experience</strong></label>
 <select class="form-control" id="experience" name="experience">
 <option>New / Peer Mentoring</option>
 <option selected>1–2 Years</option>
 <option>3–5 Years</option>
 <option>5+ Years</option>
 </select>
 </div>
 </div>
 </div>

 <div class="form-group">
 <label for="subjects"><strong>Subjects You Can Teach *</strong></label>
 <input type="text" class="form-control" id="subjects" name="subjects" placeholder="e.g. AP Physics, Calculus, Python, Data Science, SAT Math" required>
 </div>

 <div class="form-group">
 <label for="bio"><strong>Why do you want to join Elevate?</strong></label>
 <textarea id="bio" class="form-control" name="bio" rows="4" placeholder="Briefly share your teaching approach and academic background..."></textarea>
 </div>

 <div class="text-center" style="margin-top: 25px;">
 <button type="submit" class="btn btn-template-main btn-block btn-lg"><i class="fas fa-user-plus"></i> Submit Application</button>
 <p class="help-block text-muted" style="margin-top: 10px;">Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. We'll be in touch within 2–3 business days.</p>
 </div>
 </form>
</div>

item.title: Purpose & What We Do
item.description:
At Elevate Tutoring, our mission is to close educational gaps, spark genuine curiosity, and empower students with lifelong problem-solving skills — fostering academic confidence and independence.

Comprehensive Tutoring Programs

K–12 Mathematics

From foundational arithmetic and Pre-Algebra through Calculus AB/BC and Multivariable Calculus.

Sciences & AP Courses

Comprehensive coaching in Biology, Chemistry, Physics (1/2/C), and Environmental Science.
